The German, English and Polish Wikipedia articles (R2309, R2308, R2310) all put the 5th Infantry Division on the Westwall during the Polish campaign and say it did not take part in the invasion, so this Kennedy Map 7 and Chart 4 pin is probably a confusion with the 5th Panzer Division. Kennedy Chart 4 also names the commander as Generalleutnant v. Vietinghoff, whereas those articles name Wilhelm Fahrmbacher as the 5th Infantry's commander at this date. The claim is kept so Kennedy's reading stays visible, at the lowest confidence.
